fields.label: Category
fields.description: For example Student, Teacher, Staff, Public member.

fields.label: Loan Days
fields.description: How long a book may be kept before it is due.

fields.label: Books at Once
fields.description: Most books a member of this category may have on loan. 0 = no limit.

fields.label: Renewals
fields.description: How many times one loan may be extended.

fields.label: Holds at Once
fields.description: Most holds (waiting for a book that is out). 0 = no limit.

fields.label: Fine per Day
fields.description: Charged for each day a book is returned late. 0 = no fines.

fields.label: Grace Days
fields.description: Days after the due date before a fine starts.

fields.label: Fine Cap per Loan
fields.description: A late fine never goes above this. 0 = no cap.

fields.label: Block Borrowing Over
fields.description: A member who owes more than this cannot borrow until they pay. 0 = never blocked for fines.

fields.label: Membership Lasts (months)
fields.description: A new membership ends this many months on. 0 = no end date.
